title: A Primer of the Plain Maul
summary: Teaches the first lifts and falls of the two-handed maul to an untrained beginner using only body strength.

title: Workbook of the Two-Hand Swing
summary: Drills students in gripping the maul with both hands and swinging its weight in a few plain arcs.

title: Handbook of Haft and Head
summary: Explains which blows come from the maul head and which come from the haft and how to switch between them.

title: The Quarryman's Maul Lessons
summary: Carries the plain lessons of heavy stone-breaking labour over into striking and guarding with the maul.

title: Short Treatise on Overhead Blows
summary: Sets out the overhead family of maul blows and the hip and back work that makes each one land.

title: Drill-Book of the Driving Maul
summary: Drills the first qi-lit driving blows of the maul for students who already circulate their own qi.

title: Canon of the Breaking Blow
summary: Teaches how a little circulating qi in the arms deepens each plain maul blow without tiring the wielder.

title: A Student's Guide to Maul Footing
summary: Teaches the stance and step work that keep a heavy-headed maul under control through a whole exchange.

title: The Weight-Carrying Workbook
summary: Trains a student to carry and recover the maul's weight between blows with qi eased into the shoulders.

title: Treatise on the Wedge and Poll
summary: Treats the narrow splitting face and the flat poll of the maul and the qi-assisted blow suited to each.
